# sundial-subagent-driven-development

<!-- awf:edit positioning: default; create .awf/skills/parts/subagent-driven-development/positioning.md to override -->
The subagent implementation chain iterates phases. It preserves sequential implementation dispatch and exclusive implementation-tool batching.
<!-- awf:edit per-task-review-note: default; create .awf/skills/parts/subagent-driven-development/per-task-review-note.md to override -->
**Phase review is report-only.** The parent settles findings after the phase-closing commit.
<!-- awf:edit when-to-invoke: default; create .awf/skills/parts/subagent-driven-development/when-to-invoke.md to override -->
## When to invoke

Invoke when a plan phase benefits from delegated implementation ownership. A plan may mix modes; hand inline phases to `sundial-executing-plans`.

## Procedure
<!-- awf:edit procedure-resolve-plan: default; create .awf/skills/parts/subagent-driven-development/procedure-resolve-plan.md to override -->
1. Resolve the mutable plan and read every declared phase mode.
<!-- awf:edit procedure-raise-concerns: default; create .awf/skills/parts/subagent-driven-development/procedure-raise-concerns.md to override -->
2. Stop for missing phase context, paths, boundaries, checks, or closing subject.
<!-- awf:edit procedure-extract-context: default; create .awf/skills/parts/subagent-driven-development/procedure-extract-context.md to override -->
3. Per `docs/maintainable-code-design.md`, preserve the plan's settled structural choices, including a bounded enabling refactor; reassess them if grounded source contradicts them and stop and escalate rather than accept a bolt-on workaround. Extract the complete phase: goal, ordered tasks, exact paths, semantic boundary and ownership, external/internal representations and their translation point, allowed dependency direction, preparatory-refactor decision, prohibited bolt-on shortcuts, validation expectations, dependencies, prior phase commits, checks, closing subject, and V2 operation batch. The owner runs `awf context <the phase's exact paths>` before editing.
If the context command returns exactly the two-line `AWF_CONTEXT_SPILL_V1` notice, read the file named on its second line and verify that its byte length equals the `bytes=<decimal>` descriptor before treating its contents as the context packet. Best-effort delete the named file after packet use, whether packet use succeeds or fails. Treat any other output as the context packet itself; do not interpret a near-match as a spill notice.
The owner preserves the settled design or reports invalidating source facts; does not replan, broaden the task, or perform unrelated cleanup.
<!-- awf:edit dispatch-conventions: default; create .awf/skills/parts/subagent-driven-development/dispatch-conventions.md to override -->
4. For a `subagent-driven` phase, verify a known clean and green baseline. Call one implementation child alone in its parent tool batch with `allowCommits: true`, optionally set exact `model` as `provider/model-id`; omission inherits the parent, and the complete phase. The commit-capable owner performs all ordered work. Stage the complete transaction, run `awf check --staged`, then `./x gate`. Commit only after both commands pass; the hook repeats the staged check as defense in depth, then creates the declared phase-closing commit. Never dispatch concurrent implementers or helpers as phase owners.
<!-- awf:edit procedure-status-handling: default; create .awf/skills/parts/subagent-driven-development/procedure-status-handling.md to override -->
5. Validate the reported commit and clean checkout, then dispatch one report-only phase review. The parent owns focused settlement commits and checkpoints only after findings resolve. If an owner stops dirty, inventory `git status --short`, diff, completed and remaining work, prior concerns, and failed checks. Choose parent completion, restore the known green baseline and redispatch the complete revised phase, or stop for user input. An explicit transfer carries the complete revised phase, dirty-state inventory, completed and remaining work, prior concerns, and recovery verification; a blind successor instruction for one task is forbidden.
<!-- awf:edit per-task-review: default; create .awf/skills/parts/subagent-driven-development/per-task-review.md to override -->
6. Review is report-only and phase-level; review fixes remain parent-owned and do not recreate the original transaction.
<!-- awf:edit final-task-adr-flip: default; create .awf/skills/parts/subagent-driven-development/final-task-adr-flip.md to override -->
7. Apply V2 batches atomically with matching claims and lifecycle events in the owning phase.
<!-- awf:edit terminal-step: default; create .awf/skills/parts/subagent-driven-development/terminal-step.md to override -->
8. After all settled phases, invoke `sundial-reviewing-impl`.

## Notes
<!-- awf:edit notes: default; create .awf/skills/parts/subagent-driven-development/notes.md to override -->
- Sequential dispatch only, never parallel. Helpers remain sequential, commit-disabled, path-disjoint, and parent-integrated.
- Expected output is non-negotiable.
<!-- awf:edit red-flags: default; create .awf/skills/parts/subagent-driven-development/red-flags.md to override -->
## Red flags

Do not casually dispatch over a dirty checkout, infer plan-wide mode, or let a helper own a shared file or closing commit.
